holdings.infrastructureStrategyBasis: Ancala established Phoenix Rail as a dedicated short line rail infrastructure platform, consistent with its transport infrastructure investment strategy.
holdings.northAmericaBasis: Phoenix Rail operates short line freight rail and intermodal infrastructure across the United States.

evidence.title: About Phoenix Rail
evidence.evidenceSummary: Phoenix Rail is a U.S.-based rail infrastructure platform formed by Ancala and Arkadia and acquired Lehigh Valley Rail Management; confirms ongoing ownership and U.S. operations.

evidence.title: Arkadia forms Phoenix Rail to acquire Lehigh Valley Rail Management
evidence.evidenceSummary: Announcement confirms Ancala-led acquisition, formation of a U.S. rail platform, and a significant controlling stake.

evidence.title: Phoenix Rail – Ancala portfolio
evidence.evidenceSummary: Ancala portfolio page lists Phoenix Rail as an active transport infrastructure investment platform.

holdings.repoDispositionRationale: Repository headquarters (Pennsylvania) differs from company-disclosed headquarters (Denver, Colorado) and stake is now disclosed as a significant controlling stake.

holdings.infrastructureStrategyBasis: Valentra consists of critical chemical pipeline-connected production, storage, and transportation infrastructure assets aligned with Ancala’s utilities strategy.
holdings.northAmericaBasis: Valentra operates industrial pipeline and chemical infrastructure assets across Texas and Louisiana in the United States.

evidence.title: Valentra – Company website
evidence.evidenceSummary: Valentra is owned by Ancala and operates Gulf Coast chemical infrastructure assets, confirming ownership, infrastructure nature, U.S. operations, and current active status.

evidence.title: Valentra – Ancala portfolio
evidence.evidenceSummary: Ancala portfolio page lists Valentra as an active utilities investment platform with U.S. Gulf Coast operations.

evidence.title: Sidley advises Hexion on sale of assets to Ancala
evidence.evidenceSummary: Confirms Ancala completed acquisition of Gulf Coast chemical infrastructure assets forming Valentra.

holdings.repoDispositionRationale: Repository lists headquarters as Texas and sector as Midstream; sources indicate headquarters in Geismar, Louisiana and classification under utilities infrastructure.

excludedCandidates.rationale: Noventa entered bankruptcy proceedings in March 2026 and is no longer an active operating infrastructure platform, so it does not meet required ownership states.
Oxane Energy operates in the United Kingdom and is listed by Ancala as a current portfolio company outside North America.
Grupo Supera is a Spain/Portugal leisure infrastructure investment and therefore outside North America despite being a current or pending Ancala investment.

repoOnlyRecords.rationale: Company has entered bankruptcy and is no longer an active infrastructure operating platform; not listed in current Ancala portfolio.

unresolvedConflicts.subject: Noventa Energy Partners ownership status
unresolvedConflicts.issue: Ancala-linked entities appear as shareholders/creditors in bankruptcy, but no public disclosure confirms formal exit or write-off of equity.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Review bankruptcy filings or Ancala investor disclosures to confirm final disposition of equity and timing of any write-off.

notes: Reviewed full Ancala portfolio page and news archive; no additional North American holdings identified beyond Phoenix Rail and Valentra.
